findings.evidence: TypeA.lean:163-182 (`private noncomputable def plainFrobenius`, `typeAGraphFrobenius`; `frobenius`/`twistedFrobenius` defined from them); TypeA.lean:225,236 unfold them in-module via `frobenius.eq_def, plainFrobenius.eq_def`, which is unavailable to importers; TwistedFrobenius.lean:172 `twistedFrobenius_comp_self`, :205 `map_subtype_fixedSubgroup_twistedFrobenius_le`.
findings.fix: Delete the four wrapper defs and define `steinberg` directly by `SlStd.frobenius rank q.p q.exponent _` / `SlStd.twistedFrobenius rank q.p q.exponent _`, restating `steinberg_ofA`/`steinberg_ofTwistedA` against those; or keep the wrappers and add `@[simp] frobenius_def`/`twistedFrobenius_def` proved `:= (rfl)`. Also state the L1 order relation at index level (`(ofTwistedA ..).steinberg.comp (ofTwistedA ..).steinberg = SlStd.frobenius rank q.p (2 * q.exponent) _`) from `SlStd.twistedFrobenius_comp_self`.
findings.issue: `frobenius` and `twistedFrobenius` are public non-exposed `def`s whose bodies go through the *private* `plainFrobenius`/`typeAGraphFrobenius`, and no lemma states `frobenius rank q h = SlStd.frobenius rank q.p q.exponent _` or `twistedFrobenius rank q h = SlStd.twistedFrobenius rank q.p q.exponent _`. Since bodies are unexposed across modules (cf. the `@[expose]` on `LieTypeIndex.dynkinType`, Index.lean:224) and the private helpers are not importable, `steinberg_ofA`/`steinberg_ofTwistedA` terminate in dead ends: `SlStd.twistedFrobenius_comp_self`, `SlStd.graphAutomorphismPoints_comp_frobenius`, `SlStd.frobenius_weightTorusPoints`, `SlStd.map_subtype_fixedSubgroup_frobenius_eq` and `SlStd.map_subtype_fixedSubgroup_twistedFrobenius_le` are all unreachable from `d.steinberg`. The docstring at lines 40-43 asserts the opposite ("`steinberg_ofTwistedA` identifies this file's branch with that map").

findings.evidence: TypeA.lean:159-161 definition; TypeA.lean:226,237 `simp only [simpleRootSubgroup]` inside the proof; Basic.lean:529 `rootSubgroupPoints`, :550 `coe_rootSubgroupPoints` — the repo's own convention of pairing every carrier `def` with a `coe_`/`_def` restatement.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp] theorem simpleRootSubgroup_def (d : TypeALieIndex) (i : Fin d.1.rank) : d.simpleRootSubgroup i = SlStd.rootSubgroupPoints d.1.rank (.inl i) d.1.Closure := (rfl)` (and/or a `coe_simpleRootSubgroup` matching `SlStd.coe_rootSubgroupPoints`).
findings.issue: `simpleRootSubgroup` is a non-exposed `def` with no characteristic lemma. Nothing states `d.simpleRootSubgroup i = SlStd.rootSubgroupPoints d.1.rank (.inl i) d.1.Closure`, so the whole upstream root-subgroup API (`SlStd.coe_rootSubgroupPoints`, the generation results in `StandardCarrier/Generation.lean`, `weightTorus_conj_rootSubgroup`, `graphAutomorphismPoints_rootSubgroupPoints`) is unreachable through it; `steinberg_simpleRootSubgroup` is the only fact a consumer has, and even the file itself can only prove that by unfolding (`simp only [simpleRootSubgroup]`).

findings.evidence: TypeA.lean:108-116 (the two introductions); TypeA.lean:186-194 and 217-244 show the fifteen-constructor split that any consumer must otherwise reproduce.
findings.fix: Add an eliminator, e.g. `theorem exists_eq (d : TypeALieIndex) : (∃ rank q h, d = ofA rank q h) ∨ (∃ rank q h, d = ofTwistedA rank q h)`, or an `@[elab_as_elim]` `casesOn'` recursor covering the two branches.
findings.issue: `ofA`/`ofTwistedA` are the introduction forms but there is no matching elimination, so every consumer holding an abstract `d : TypeALieIndex` must redo the fifteen-branch subtype case split with thirteen `contradiction` branches — exactly the boilerplate `steinberg_simpleRootSubgroup` performs at lines 217-244, and which the eventual `ValidLieTypeIndex` dispatcher and all downstream work will repeat.

summary: The Steinberg maps and the simple-root subgroup are exported as non-exposed `def`s built through private helpers, with no `_def` lemma identifying them with `SlStd.frobenius`, `SlStd.twistedFrobenius`, or `SlStd.rootSubgroupPoints`, so no downstream consumer can reach any of the upstream API — including the L1 relations the file's own docstring claims it makes available.
